lines.text: A bathroom remodel done in seven days. Sounds awesome, right?
At Luxury Home Renovations, we are looking for 10 homes with outdated bathrooms that we can remodel at a discounted rate, in return for using the before and after videos on our website.
To qualify, your bathroom has to be five years or older.
You have to be looking for either a full bathroom remodel or a tub to shower conversion.
And you have to be ready to get started within the next 30 days.
We are only looking for 10 homeowners for this showcase, so if you think your bathroom might be a good fit...
Hit the "Get Quote" button below, answer a few short questions, and we will contact you to see if you qualify.
